propositions: Existing managed links must be backfilled as confirmed-at-upgrade when store file is absent on first post-upgrade run to prevent regression of declining all legitimate peer deletions
Backfill runs conditionally only when store file was absent (fresh upgrade), not when store exists but is empty, to avoid silently re-populating legitimately cleared stores

Backfill must check existing records before writing and skip keys already carrying push or snapshot records to prevent provenance downgrade, while later snapshot confirmations can overwrite backfilled entries

The evidence step must use a single store instance opened once, with backfill running before snapshot confirmation on the same instance, then saved once, to ensure backfilled records are visible to snapshot and prevent lost-update race conditions
A backfilled record with source=backfill and direction=backfill is treated as confirmed by is_confirmed() without distinguishing backfill from proof at the decision point
